test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Fetal ______ screening uses ultrasound scanning to find certain abnormalities in the baby.
solution: The correct answer is **"anomaly."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Anomaly"** means something that deviates from what is considered normal or expected. (कुछ ऐसा जो सामान्य या अपेक्षित मानी जाने वाली चीज़ से भटक जाता है) • Example: *The doctor **found an **anomaly**__ in the ultrasound report of the fetus.* • It is the most appropriate word to describe abnormalities found in fetal screening using ultrasound scanning. • So, the correct answer is **option 2**. **Correct sentence:** *Fetal __**anomaly**__ screening uses ultrasound scanning to find certain abnormalities in the baby.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Enfevering"** means causing or experiencing fever. (बुखार पैदा करना या अनुभव करना) • **"Abeyance"** means temporary suspension or inactivity. (अस्थायी निलंबन या निष्क्रियता) • **"Snuggle"** means to curl up or nestle closely to someone or something. (किसी से सटकर बैठना, छाती से लगना आदि (सुरक्षा, गरमी और आराम के अनुभव के लिए)) 1c6:Tb6c, The correct answer is **"alleviate".**
